name: creative-team-v2
prompt: Photorealistic editorial agency photograph, vertical 2:3 composition. A fictional adult female creative strategist aged 28, black shoulder-length waves, olive complexion, loose pale blue shirt with sleeves rolled up, sitting sideways at a round meeting table, smiling naturally while gesturing with one hand toward a colleague just outside frame. Candid conversational moment, looking to the left of camera, not posing for headshot. Medium shot from hips upward, visible sketchbook and small colour swatches on table lower foreground. Sophisticated actual creative studio background with a huge coral and cobalt abstract geometric wall print, daylight, tactile paper posters, shallow depth of field. Colour photography, lively but restrained. Person occupies centre 65% with face in upper third. Authentic skin texture, natural anatomy, plausible hand fingers, no glossy beauty retouch, no logos, no text. Entire photo must feel like a real agency meeting captured by documentary photographer.

name: media-buying-team-v2

Real natural window light, medium contrast black and white analogue editorial photograph, slight film grain, realistic skin and hands. No text, no logos, not a frontal studio headshot. Authentic spontaneous moment at work.
